beats.name: THE ARRIVALS GATE
cap: the Prime Minister's voiceover plays over families
embracing at Heathrow before Christmas
beats.tag: FRAME — the arrivals hall the film ends in

beats.name: BILLY MACK
cap: Billy Mack records a novelty Christmas single and
mocks it while manager Joe books the chat shows
beats.tag: BFF — Joe takes the jokes and stays

beats.name: DOWNING STREET
cap: New prime minister David meets Natalie, a junior
staffer at Number 10, and likes her at once
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — Downing Street, of all places

beats.name: JAMIE'S HOME TRUTH
cap: Jamie finds his girlfriend with his own brother and
leaves London to write in the south of France
beats.tag: BREAKUP — he puts a country between them

beats.name: THE HOUSEKEEPER
cap: At the French house Jamie falls for Aurelia, who
keeps the place and shares not one word of English
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — they fall in love by sign language

beats.name: DANIEL AND SAM
cap: Daniel is bringing up his stepson Sam alone; his
wife has died and Sam loves a girl in his class
beats.tag: FAMILY — grief and a crush in one house

beats.name: THE NECKLACE
cap: Harry buys a gold necklace for his assistant Mia;
his wife Karen sees him pay and says nothing
beats.tag: BREAKUP — the marriage turns on a shop counter

beats.name: THE SCHOOL CONCERT
cap: Sam has learned the drums to impress Joanna and
plays the school Christmas show to reach her
beats.tag: GESTURE — the stepfather sits in the front row

beats.name: THE CUE CARDS
cap: Mark calls at Juliet's door on Christmas Eve with
cards that say he loves her, then walks away
beats.tag: GESTURE — a confession that asks for nothing

beats.name: CHRISTMAS EVE
cap: Karen unwraps a Joni Mitchell CD instead of the
necklace, and cries in the bedroom on her own
beats.tag: BREAKUP — she thanks him and keeps the peace

beats.name: THE AIRPORT RUN
cap: Sam runs past airport security to tell Joanna he
loves her before her flight back to America
beats.tag: GESTURE — the boy outruns the film's grownups

beats.name: ARRIVALS
cap: At Heathrow arrivals Jamie proposes to Aurelia in
Portuguese, and the film returns where it began
beats.tag: CODA — back where the voiceover started
